Deviation_in_Dispatch.cpt_accuracy_assessment: The CPT is structurally valid: it matches the ground-truth shape, all probabilities are within range, and every column sums to one. However, parameter accuracy is poor. The mean absolute error is 0.313125, the maximum absolute error is 0.89, there are no close parameters, and most parameters (20 of 32) have severe error. This indicates the CPT values differ substantially from the ground truth despite being a valid probability table.
main_cpt_issues: Although the CPT shape is correct, the parameter values are highly inaccurate overall.
No parameters fall within the close-error threshold.
A majority of parameters (20 out of 32) have severe error greater than 0.20.
The maximum absolute error of 0.89 indicates at least one parameter is extremely far from the ground truth.
The mean absolute error of 0.313125 is high for a CPT parameter comparison.

overall_cpt_analysis.summary: Overall CPT quality is poor. While all assessed node CPTs are structurally valid and normalized, parameter accuracy is weak across the network. Four of seven nodes are rated poor, two are fair, and only one is excellent. The poorest performance is concentrated in Deviation_in_Dispatch, Deviation_in_Response, Root_Causes, and Execution_Integrity, all of which show substantial divergence from ground-truth probabilities, including many severe parameter errors and large maximum absolute errors.
main_reasons: Most node CPTs are rated poor (4 of 7), outweighing the limited number of fair and excellent nodes.
Several key nodes have high mean absolute error and many severe parameter deviations, especially Deviation_in_Response, Deviation_in_Dispatch, and Root_Causes.
Execution_Integrity is also rated poor despite some close entries because a substantial fraction of its parameters have severe errors.
Only one node, Program_Anomaly, is excellent, which is not enough to offset the broader pattern of inaccurate CPT parameterization.
The remaining fair nodes, Network_Manipulation and Physical_Anomaly, still contain noticeable mismatches and do not raise the network-level quality above poor.
